data.title: Key Lazio Midfielder Should Recover for Parma – The Probable Lineup - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
In the backline, Romano Floriani Mussolini and Nuno Tavares should flank Josip Sutalo and Oliver Provstgaard, with the in-form Christos Mandas starting behind them in goal. Despite Matteo Cancellieri's return from injury, Gustav Isaksen will keep his place on the right wing. Club captain Mattia Zaccagni will start on the opposite side, with Tijjani Noslin leading the line.

## Tijjani Noslin the Favourite Over Andrea Pinamonti [...] According to La Lazio Siamo Noi, the head coach should keep his starting lineup intact, especially with Taylor overcoming the slight knock he suffered in Turin on Sunday. The Dutchman should thus take his place in the midfield trio alongside Davide Frattesi and Reda Belahyane, while Danilo Cataldi and Fisayo Dele-Bashiru start the contest on the bench.

## Lazio Lineup Remains Intact [...] Sky Sport Italia and La Gazzetta dello Sport are reporting the same expected Lazio lineup, although the pink newspaper leaves a 30% chance for Andrea Pinamonti to replace Noslin upfront after contributing with a goal and an assist in his last two cameos against Monza and Juventus.
